episode_event_vote_miniepisode/4001_1001: Heya! We’re here to cover café prep!

Everyone is so dedicated—and listens to
each other’s ideas, including my own.

You’re only in the prep stage, but it looks
like it’s getting lots of attention already!
We have to work even harder on the menu!
Glad to see everyone’s having fun!

Before we let you get back to prepping,
can you share any top-secret details?
Hmm, let’s see. I guess, if anything...

Darach will be coaching our service, but we
thought it’d be nice to create buzz another
way too.

We’re going to prepare the best café. I hope
everyone enjoys it!

That’s what I like to hear! Getting behind-
the-scenes stories like this is what makes
interviewing fun!

I can’t wait to see how the café turns out.
We’re so excited!
